items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: I will see Taylor Hackford some day and we’ll discuss this.

ctx.x: What did you think of the Ray Charles movie?

I liked it. I thought it was terrific. I didn’t dig the way they made Fathead look, ‘cause that is nothing like he is. You know, even in his worst drug days when he was a young man he was a gentleman. They used him as like an evil foil. He didn’t turn Ray Charles — I mean I liked the movie, I thought Jamie Foxx was great you know. I liked it. I like what Taylor did, the whole thing. But I don’t like the way they made Fathead look and neither does Fathead. I will see Taylor Hackford some day and we’ll discuss this.
